name: Chase Tramont

items.text: In a July 2022 candidate debate, reported by the Daytona Beach News-Journal, Tramont said the separation of church and state does not appear in the Constitution or founding documents. He said he strongly supports religious liberty.
items.why: This is a statement of constitutional opinion, not conduct bearing on any criterion, and the platform score covers his stances.

for_review: The owner-site search (Tramont with alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org and infowars.com) found nothing about him. I did not search for other controversies, such as finances, contracts or ethics complaints, because the 4-search limit went to the listed item and the owner-site search. The 2022 News-Journal article is the original source of the quote. It describes his work as a marketing manager at DME Delivers, which a reviewer could check for the 'real work' criterion.
